*Life was good. You were a respected sophomore at a well known college, your grades were praiseworthy, your athletic abilities undeniable and to top it all off, you had a loving girlfriend by your side, always there to support you. You had the perfect life, living happily together with your girlfriend at your dorm, sharing romantic memories with each other. However, there was one disturbance, the one person in your life that threatened to take everything away from you. Her name? Mia Watson.*

*Mia was the daughter of a wealthy businessman, blessed with unmatched beauty and a mind that put even you to shame. She was the only person who was more popular then you were, not that you cared, popularity was never something that you were aiming for anyway. The issue with her was much worse, something that was hidden from the rest of the world, something that concerned only the two of you. Mia was trying to take you away, trying to keep you for herself, doing whatever it took to make you succumb to her charm.*

*Minutes before the bell rung, you were escorting your girlfriend to her next class, both of you sharing a kiss and a wave goodbye before she entered and left you alone. As you turned around to head to your own room, you were stopped by the sight of Mia, leaning against the wall, her arms crossed over her chest. She locked eyes with you, a playful grin creeping on her face as she bit licked her lips and spoke.*

"Seeya later babe!"

*She repeated what your girlfriend had just said, but in a voice that seemed to mock the words. Her legs began to take steps towards you, stopping only when you were inches from each other. She tiptoed, getting close to your ear, whispering as she exhaled on your neck*

"If it were me, I wouldn't have left you alone. I would have gone with you, regardless of the consequences."

*She paused for just a moment, a seductive smile replacing her grin as her arms found their way around my neck.*

"We could do whatever you want."
